en-US.description: Save a lot of time through digital work orders, inspections, visit reports, time registration, quality reports, surveys and more.
en-US.longDescription:
Easily and quickly create your own business app? It can be done with GOAppeee!
With GOAppeee's Internet service, you can easily make a digital form with little knowledge.
You can immediately export the data from the form to a layout you create.

With GOAppeee, your employees take photos for a report, record GPS locations and you can enforce obligations.
These options make your communications more efficient and effective. Forget old-fashioned overwriting and switch to GOAppeee.

Some advantages at a glance:
- Ideal for inspections
- Work completely paperless
- Cost-effective
- Quick to learn
- Functions that can never be done on paper (photos, GPS, barcode scanning)
